messages.subject: Your witness statement — draft to review
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

Thank you for the time last week. I've put your evidence into a draft witness statement covering the supply arrangement, the 316L requirement, the failures, and the steps Pennington took. The key passage rebuts their suggestion that you approved a different grade, and deals with the June 2024 torque change.

Please read it carefully — it must be in your own words and entirely accurate, as you'll sign a statement of truth. Mark anything that isn't right and we'll revise before the 12 September exchange deadline.

Best,
James

--

messages.subject: RE: Your witness statement — draft to review
messages.plaintextBody:
James — this is good and largely accurate. Two corrections: the torque revision was ECN-PX-118 (not 117), and we quarantined stock on the 12th, not the 14th. Otherwise I'm happy to sign. The point about compliant housings not failing under the same revised spec is exactly right and worth emphasising.

Henry

--
Pennington Industries Limited
14 Faraday Court, Aston, Birmingham B7 4AA
